message: I have a friend who turns every weather forecast into a full-blown disaster movie. Last week, she called me in a tizzy over a mild storm warning, convinced we were days away from an epic flood. I just chuckled and reminded her of my favorite saying: it’s always good to be prepared, but it’s even better to keep your sense of humor. After all, a little calm goes a long way in the face of a storm, right? What’s your go-to strategy for staying chill during a weather scare?
